title: Generation of vortex-squeezed light in a coherently prepared medium
summary: In this Letter, we theoretically propose an alternative scheme for generating vortex optical squeezing, based on the Raman scattering process in a coherently prepared medium, distinct from approaches such as parametric down-conversion and four-wave mixing. Our analysis reveals that both the input control field and the generated signal field can exhibit squeezing upon adjusting the relevant system parameters, with the control field exhibiting a greater degree of squeezing under identical conditions.
